title: Storage: Claude can edit a file by sending only the change
text: Claude can now find, open and change files in Storage without sending the whole file again, using five new tools that work only in Antonio's own session. A change to a file the client can see is not applied directly: it waits as a proposal in the file's version list, with a note, an Accept this change button and a Discard button. Other changes are saved as a new numbered version and the old copy is kept.
points: The tools only work once Antonio switches Claude's file access on.
Accepting a proposal asks whether the client should see the new version.
A proposal made from an older version is refused when the file has since moved on, so newer work is never undone.
Signed files, passports and IDs, replaced files and filed files are never changed this way.
